spoken_summary: Donald Trump discusses a plan to redo parks, focusing specifically on replacing the grass. He makes an analogy that grass has a lifetime, just like people, and claims the current grass is "old, tired, exhausted." He concludes by saying, "We're going to redo the grass with the finest grasses."
